name: wildcat-home
description: The unified landing page for the Wildcat.chat platform, featuring all Wildcat tools (Sage, WildcatTTS, and Chat Overlay) with consistent branding and modern design.

scripts.check:design-system: cmp -s ../wildcat-design-system/design-system.css src/styles/design-system.css && echo design-system.css in sync || (echo design-system.css has drifted from ../wildcat-design-system && exit 1)
scripts.check: npm run check:design-system && npm run build && npm test
